title: The model endpoint is overloaded or rate limited
description: The model endpoint returns overload or rate-limit errors; admission control must shed nonessential work and keep safety and human routes available.
callerVisible: The caller is offered the non-AI route or a person without a long silence.
notes: Added to the fixed fault registry for the follow-on prompt section 17 fault matrix. The LOCAL FIXTURE driver does not inject it (NOT_SUPPORTED); only the Layer-2 run tagged [FAULT:MODEL_OVERLOAD] owned by WP-17 proves it.

registry.injectionPoint: the model emulator returns overload/rate-limit errors

postconditions: Overload is classified and retried within budget only
Safety and human routes stay available
